import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))

# Color palette for species
species_colors = {'setosa': '#FF6B6B', 'versicolor': '#4ECDC4', 'virginica': '#45B7D1'}

# 1. Pairplot-style scatter: Petal Length vs Petal Width
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
for species in df['species'].unique():
    species_data = df[df['species'] == species]
    ax1.scatter(species_data['petal_length'], species_data['petal_width'], 
                label=species, alpha=0.7, s=80, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5,
                color=species_colors[species])
ax1.set_xlabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Petal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Species', frameon=True, shadow=True)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 2. Sepal Length vs Sepal Width
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
for species in df['species'].unique():
    species_data = df[df['species'] == species]
    ax2.scatter(species_data['sepal_length'], species_data['sepal_width'], 
                label=species, alpha=0.7, s=80, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5,
                color=species_colors[species])
ax2.set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Sepal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax2.legend(title='Species', frameon=True, shadow=True)
ax2.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 3. Box plot for Petal Length distribution
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
box_data = [df[df['species'] == species]['petal_length'].values for species in df['species'].unique()]
bp = ax3.boxplot(box_data, labels=df['species'].unique(), patch_artist=True,
                  notch=True, showmeans=True)
for patch, species in zip(bp['boxes'], df['species'].unique()):
    patch.set_facecolor(species_colors[species])
    patch.set_alpha(0.7)
ax3.set_xlabel('Species', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Petal Length Distribution', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 4. Violin plot for Sepal Length distribution
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
species_list = df['species'].unique()
positions = range(len(species_list))
for i, species in enumerate(species_list):
    data = df[df['species'] == species]['sepal_length'].values
    parts = ax4.violinplot([data], positions=[i], widths=0.7, showmeans=True, showmedians=True)
    for pc in parts['bodies']:
        pc.set_facecolor(species_colors[species])
        pc.set_alpha(0.7)
        pc.set_edgecolor('black')
        pc.set_linewidth(1.5)

ax4.set_xticks(positions)
ax4.set_xticklabels(species_list)
ax4.set_xlabel('Species', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Sepal Length Distribution', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# Overall title
fig.suptitle('Iris Dataset: Comprehensive Species Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.99])

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
